name: dgpowers
description: Brainstorm, map and mock up the UI before planning, plan as a task graph, and build in parallel with a review per task. Adapted from superpowers.

interface.shortDescription: From idea to reviewed code: design, UI mockups, graph plans, parallel builds
interface.longDescription: dgpowers walks a change from brainstorming to a design doc with a UI map, draws mockups of every screen it touches for you to pick, writes the plan as a task graph, and builds it with a fresh implementer and reviewer per task, running independent tasks in parallel.
defaultPrompt: I've got an idea for something I'd like to build.
Let's add a feature to this project.
